notes:
Index NAMES AND MYTHS: 105 entities with 369 unit hits in total. I read all three texts in full and modified none of them.

HOW THE PATTERNS WERE TESTED
- Each text was split into the specified units:
  - zacher-1: c<N> = latin+ru+en; n<N> = ru+en.
  - odyssey-10: s1–s4 = Greek + translations + segment header/review log; n1a…n4a = RU and EN note merged by id.
  - study-laestrygonians: abstract = Аннотация + Abstract; s1–s6; n1–n38; appx-1…12. Литература is excluded.
- Every pattern was run against the whole text of each unit with the anchor (?<!\w), and the hits were counted per unit. Every pattern listed hits at least once. A loose stem search found no missed case forms.
- Exclusions are built into the patterns as negative lookaheads/lookbehinds, so they work whatever the scanner does with `exclude`. Each `exclude` entry repeats the false-hit phrase, anchored at the hit position.

FALSE HITS GUARDED AGAINST
- «Александр Михельс» (editor, odyssey-10 s3 review log).
- Planets in Zacher ch. 4: Юпитер/Iovem/Jupiter and Меркурий/Mercurium/Mercury.
- Attalus of Rhodes (article s4, n17).
- Ptolemy's Almagest (article n24).
- Pausanias the periegete (Zacher n71).
- The poem title in quotes («Одиссее», „Одиссее“): handled by a lookbehind in the Odysseus pattern; the genitive «Одиссеи» is excluded by its form.
- Александрия/александрийцы, Гефестион vs Гефест, Vulcano vs Vulcan, Клитомах/Клитарх vs Клит, Аполлодор vs Аполлон, Эолия/Эоловы острова vs Эол, Ἱπποτάδης vs Ἱππότου, Ὀδύσσεια vs Ὀδυσσεύς.

PEOPLES
- Only ethnonym nouns are matched, including singulars: египтянин, фиванец, an Egyptian, a Macedonian.
- Adjectives are deliberately not matched (египетский, персидский, тирийские, Persian, Theban soldiers, скифскую).
- [Лл]естригон also covers Лестригония (the land) and лестригонский.

MERGED ENTRIES
- Зевс → Юпитер.
- Гермес / Майей рождённый / Maiugena → Меркурий.
- Алкид → Геркулес.
- Полидевк → Поллукс.
- Гефест → Вулкан.
- Великая Мать → Кибела.
- Ланика → Алакринис.
- Улисс/Ulixes → Одиссей.

DELIBERATELY NOT INDEXED
- Authors and scholars as authors: Homer, Hesiod, Pindar, Aratus, Eudoxus, Hipparchus, Attalus of Rhodes, Crates, Aristarchus, Aristonicus, Geminus, Pytheas, Herodicus, Athenaeus, Gellius, Strabo, Eratosthenes, Apollodorus, Polybius, Thucydides, Diodorus, Plutarch, Arrian, Herodotus, Pliny, Clitarchus, Memnon, Photius, Favorinus, Vincent of Beauvais, Julius Valerius, Tzetzes, Asclepiades, Palaephatus, Eustathius, Ptolemy the astronomer, Aristyllus, Boethus, Cleanthes, and all modern editors.
- Astrological planets (Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus, Saturn in ch. 4) and constellations (голова Дракона, Телец, Пёс).
- Λάμος/Лам and Телепил are treated as places: the scholion has οἱ τὴν Λάμον οἰκοῦντες.
- галлы: a class of priests, not a name.
- Unnamed figures: Darius' mother, wife and daughters; the piper in the Latin text; the suitors.

HEADINGS AND KINDS
- «залбы» is my transliteration; the texts give only ζαλβοί.
- Night and Day (Ночь/День) appear only in article s1 (Hesiod), as capitalised forms.
